ASHA Workers Demand Higher Pay and Benefits

ASHA workers in India are protesting for better pay and benefits, citing the impact on health services. The demand includes a ₹5,000 honorarium for their Sir duties. This issue affects the country's healthcare system, highlighting the need for improved working conditions and compensation for frontline workers.
